items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Marchand, yeah. She was very good.

ctx.x: Marchand, yeah. She was very good. She really knew — it must be a type that a lot of people have for mothers because when he wanted to smother her with a pillow and held it physically, she was on oxygen and they were wheeling her out on a gurney smiling. This
is sort of a curious way of answering your question, Monk, about what music did I hear as a kid. I can’t say other than what was on the airwaves.
